description: Use this when the person asks about recalls or safety warnings in their own account. Lists the recalls and safety warnings of the connected account with kind, product, status, hazard, the instruction to stop using, what customers should do, the remedies offered (repair, replacement, refund), contact, dates and closing note. Creating, publishing, notifying recipients and closing a recall is done in the dashboard only. Do not use for public recall databases of authorities, or to create, publish or close a recall; that is done in the dashboard.

language.description: Language of the answer: "de" (German, default), "en" (English) or "pl" (Polish). Product and account answers are written in German and English; content without a translation comes in German.

name: list_recalls
title: Recalls and safety notices
